title: Convergence Radii of Autoregressive and Moving Average Persistence Series
statement: What is the radius of convergence of the power series in $\rho$ for the persistence exponent of the Gaussian autoregressive process of order one, and is the radius of convergence one for the analogous moving-average process of order one?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Stochastic Processes under Constraints (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2020/32, pp. 1601--1656](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2020/32)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-22)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** For the AR(1) series only lower bounds on the radius are known in the cited work, and the MA(1) radius-one assertion is explicitly conjectural; no complete proof of the requested radius is available.

**Sources checked.**

- [AR(1) persistence series](https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.09861)
- [MA(1) persistence series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.06870)
- [OWR report](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46870)
